note: Custom-game options for single-player skirmishes (data-driven). resources: extra starting resources added on top of the civilisation start (KoW preset values - the reference game's exact preset numbers are UNKNOWN and are not claimed). startAges: age every player starts in (1-4). speeds: game speed multipliers (view-side time scale; the deterministic tick rate is unchanged). Multiplayer ignores these options until they are synchronised by the lobby protocol.
